tools.name: search
tools.description: Use this for EPK public knowledge searches and always when one request combines property listings with guides, regulations, taxes, residency, relocation, or due diligence. It returns both result types in one response and remains compatible with company knowledge and deep research.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Use this when the user wants the full public property or guide document identified by a stable public EPK document ID or a prior search result.

id.description: Stable public EPK document ID supplied by the user or returned by search.

tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Use this when the user wants only public EPK Properties listings with explicit country, sale/rent, property type, price, bedroom, bathroom, area, location, or descriptive-keyword filters. SALE and RENT searches also include SALE_AND_RENT listings because they are available for the requested operation. If the same request also asks for guides or regulations, use search instead so both kinds appear together.

query.description: Location, property name, address, or keywords matched against public listing text.

country.description: PTY for Panama or DOM for the Dominican Republic.

language.description: Language for descriptions and canonical listing URLs.

operation_type.description: Search by availability: SALE includes SALE and SALE_AND_RENT listings; RENT includes RENT and SALE_AND_RENT listings.

max_bedrooms.description: Maximum bedrooms; set equal to min_bedrooms for an exact bedroom count.

max_bathrooms.description: Maximum bathrooms; set equal to min_bathrooms for an exact bathroom count.

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Use this when the user supplies a public EPK property UUID or wants full public details for a result returned by search_properties.

property_id.description: Stable public property UUID supplied by the user or returned by search_properties.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Use this when the user asks only for EPK public guidance about buying, taxation, regulations, residency, locations, rental management, relocation, or due diligence in Panama or the Dominican Republic. If the same request also asks for properties, use search instead so both kinds appear together.

query.description: Topic, regulation, tax, residency, location, or buying-process query.

language.description: Omit to infer the language from the query.

tools.name: get_guide_section
tools.description: Use this when the user supplies a public EPK guide section ID or wants the complete section identified by search_guides.

id.description: Stable public guide section ID supplied by the user or returned by search_guides.
